recipe.loss: Source-balanced binary bag loss with normalized log-mean-exp, plus positive-only onset support within 1.5 seconds. Other positive-source windows are unlabeled.

recipe.selection: Preserve both existing true positives and all four true negatives; recover at least one previous positive miss.
